name: MATH 151 midterm

sections.instructions: Show all work. Answers without justification receive no credit. No calculators. There are 5 problems worth a total of 50 points.

sub_parts.pattern: (a), (b), (c), each with its own points in square brackets

voice_notes: Each problem opens with one imperative or scene-setting sentence, then lettered parts.
Problems run from routine computation (limits, derivatives) to applied word problems at the end.
Word problems ask for a justification or a one-sentence interpretation in the final part.
Terse, formal wording with no hints. Mathematics is typeset, never written out in words.

exemplars.text:
Problem 2. [12 points] Differentiate each function. You do not need to simplify your answers.
(a) [4 points] $f(x) = x^3 e^{2x}$
(b) [4 points] $g(x) = \dfrac{x^2 + 1}{3x - 2}$
(c) [4 points] $h(x) = \ln(\cos x)$

Problem 4. [8 points] A ladder $5$ m long rests against a vertical wall. The bottom of the ladder slides away from the wall at $0.5$ m/s.
(a) [5 points] How fast is the top of the ladder sliding down the wall at the instant when the bottom is $3$ m from the wall?
(b) [3 points] State the units of your answer and explain in one sentence what its sign means.
